prompt.instruction: From the current NotebookLM sources, return only those that are YouTube videos. For each one, extract and return a structured JSON object using the following schema. The response should be a JSON array, where each item corresponds to a separate YouTube video.
prompt.title: YouTubeVideoInsight
prompt.description: Structured data for a YouTube video source

title.description: The title of the YouTube video

description.description: The full description or transcript summary of the video

summary.description: A concise summary of the main ideas or arguments presented

channel.description: The name of the YouTube channel

url.description: The full YouTube video URL (if available)

questions.description: 3–5 questions based on the video's content

comments.description: Simulated livestream chat user IDs from a fictional prototype (e.g. User_Skeptic, User_CoderGuru) that share thematic alignment with this video
